notes.title: Implementation of Translation Features, Optimization, Detail Adjustment
notes.notes:
We have implemented translation features for six languages (Korean, English, Chinese, Russian, Japanese, German). Since it is in the testing phase, only these six languages have been added. If the translation system works properly, it will be gradually expanded.

Optimization work has been carried out.

The position of the cup was adjusted because it was too close to the basketball.

notes.title: Improve an uninteresting map or change to a completely new map
notes.notes:
We've fixed boring maps, or completely revamped boring maps. If you still have a boring map, please let us know!

But... some of the maps are intentionally observational...

Have fun :D
